svg.title: Figure 5-1. Dependent failure initiators against the independence claims they reach, with evaluation (WP-A-03 §4, §5)
svg.desc: Matrix of the 36 dependent failure initiators DFI-01 to DFI-26 of §4 (rows, grouped by §4.1 to §4.6) against the independence claims IC-01 to IC-07 (columns). A red cell means §5 lists the initiator as not controlled for that claim, an amber cell partly controlled. Split cells show a rating that improves in the reference build. Dashed cells with a dagger are claims named in the §4 Elements reached column but not listed in §5. The bottom row gives the §5 verdict per claim: IC-01 and IC-06 not independent, IC-02, IC-04 and IC-05 partly, IC-03 open, IC-07 not applicable. 17 initiators are rated not controlled at the baseline; none is rated controlled.
